sources.title: SZU-AFS Antispoofing System for the ASVspoof 5 Challenge
sources.snippet: AI Summary This paper introduces the SZU-AFS anti-spoofing system for the ASVspoof 5 Challenge Track 1, which employs a four-stage approach: baseline model selection, data augmentation (DA) for fine-tuning, gradient norm aware minimization (GAM) for secondary fine-tuning, and score-level fusion.

sources.title: Wav2Vec2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a Wav2Vec2 model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h Configuration objects inherit from PreTrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
